messages.text: I had to submit a complaint about your system. I tried speaking with your twice for 10 minutes but both times you ended the talk by 5 minutes for no reason and told me I'd get the discount code but I didn't because it wasn't the required 10 minutes that I was willing to do.

I'm sorry about that — a cut-off interview call and a missing discount code isn't something I can fix from here, but I'll get this to the store owner directly so they can sort out your code. Could you give me the email you'd like them to reply to?
Handed to the team · Complaint: interview call ended early twice, promised discount code not received
The owner now has the full details and will follow up by email about getting your discount code sorted — usually within one business day. What's the best email to reach you at?
I filled out the contact form already.

Got it, no problem — the owner will see it and follow up with you directly. Is there anything I can help you with on the globes side while you're here, like the Quincy 9-inch you were just looking at?
Yes, I'm curious if there are other globes in stock that are similar to the Quincy.

The Forester 9" Antique Ocean Desk Globe with Walnut-Finished Hardwood Base is very close to the Quincy — same 9-inch size, the same warm antique-ocean look, and a walnut hardwood base, and it's in stock. It's a great fit if you liked the Quincy's size and style but want to compare options before deciding. Want me to point you toward anything else, like a larger size or a different finish?
Thank you.  I will look at that. I'm also curious about a 12" globe with comparable styling. I like wood bases and metal meridians.
Searched the catalog · 12 inch antique ocean desk globe wood base metal meridian

For a wood base paired with a metal meridian, the Spokane 12" Antique Ocean Desk Globe stands out — it has the same antique parchment-ocean look as the Quincy, a walnut-finished wood base, and a die-cast metal meridian with degree markings, and it's in stock at $125. The Cranbrook 12-inch is another option in the same style with a gold-toned meridian, if you'd like something a bit more refined. Want me to point you to either on the site?
I would like to look at both please.

Sure thing — both are easy to find by name on the site:

- **Spokane 12" Antique Ocean Desk Globe - Raised Relief with Walnut Base** — walnut wood base, die-cast metal meridian, antique parchment ocean.
- **Cranbrook 12-inch Antique Desk Globe with Raised Relief - Walnut Base** — same walnut wood base style, with a gold-toned die-cast meridian for a bit more shine.

Search either name in the site search bar and you'll land right on the product page to compare them side by side.
Thank you. I am having an issue. I can't access the reviews for each globe.

That's not something I can see or fix from the chat — I don't have access to the reviews widget on the product pages. I'd suggest trying a refresh or a different browser first, but if it's still not loading, I can flag it to the store owner so they can look into it. Want me to do that, and if so, what's the best email to reach you at?
